name: @epicollect5/capacitor-native-loader
description: Capacitor plugin for native animated loaders, fullscreen overlays, Lottie assets, and WebView resizing.
author: Martin Donadieu <martin@capgo.app>

scripts.verify: bun run verify:ios && bun run verify:android && bun run verify:web
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.lint: bun run eslint && bun run prettier -- --check && bun run swiftlint -- lint
scripts.fmt: bun run eslint -- --fix && bun run prettier -- --write && bun run swiftlint -- --fix --format
scripts.docgen: mkdir -p dist && bun node_modules/@capacitor/docgen/bin/docgen --api NativeLoaderPlugin --output-readme README.md --output-json dist/docs.json
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run docgen && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc && bun node_modules/rollup/dist/bin/rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
scripts.example:build: bun run build && cd example-app && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
